main_text.p: Doricé ex ζω futurum σω mutat σ in ξ: ut βαδίζω βαδίσω, vado, am: βα-διξῶ.
Atticé polysyllabum ex ιζω in ισω, circumflectitur ultima, & tollitur σ, ut νομίζω, νομίσω, puto, bo: νομιῶ.

Vbi figurativa est ρ, λ, μ, ν. Si figurativa fit é liquidis, non assumitur σ, sed ultima circumflectitur, & penultima corripitur, breviando ancipitem, tollendo é geminis vel liquidis, vel in diphthongo vocalibus, secundam: ut
main_text.l: ἐλαύνω ἐλᾱσῶ, ab ἐλάω, agito, bo.

page.notes: Greek and accented forms transcribed approximately from the scan; some accents and breathings may be misread. Long s rendered as s. Printed text is a Greek grammar with Latin commentary; the wording "ἀπερῶ" and some Greek forms are doubtful and should be checked against the original.
